checks: Administrative login uses the real service and ERP role verification
Integration account is displayed separately from administrative identity
ERP company and price selectors load and integration identity is read-only
Report filters, results, timestamps and saved views work through the service
Customer account is created in the service and mapped to ERP Customer
Edited campaign is published through shared storage into the separate customer app
Personal customer login stores no password in localStorage
Customer checkout creates an ERP draft and opens its owned order detail
Notification navigates to the permitted order
Guides contain the standalone setup, identity model and migration limitations
Administration and reports fit phone widths without page overflow
Reports-only role sees reports without management controls
backend: Real service dispatcher, SQLite and WebCrypto; Frappe HTTP fixture. Browser UI is Android assets.
